```yaml
name: Update Meeting Minutes

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # runs daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Fetch latest meeting minutes and commit
        run: |
          #!/usr/bin/env bash
          set -euo pipefail

          # Discourse community category
          CATEGORY="community"

          # Get the latest topic ID in the community category
          TOPIC_ID=$(curl -s https://discuss.layer5.io/c/${CATEGORY}/latest.json | jq -r '.topic_list.topics[0].id')
          if [[ -z "$TOPIC_ID" ]]; then
            echo "Could not find latest topic in category '${CATEGORY}'. Exiting."
            exit 1
          fi

          # Retrieve the raw content of the first post in the topic
          RAW=$(curl -s https://discuss.layer5.io/t/${TOPIC_ID}.json | jq -r '.post_stream.posts[0].raw')
          if [[ -z "$RAW" ]]; then
            echo "Could not retrieve post content. Exiting."
            exit 1
          fi

          # Prepare file path
          DATE=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
          FILE=".github/meetings/archive/meeting-${DATE}.md"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$FILE")"

          # Write content to file (overwrite if exists)
          echo "$RAW" > "$FILE"

          # Configure git
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          # Commit and push only if there are changes
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "No changes to commit."
          else
            git add "$FILE"
            git commit -m "Update meeting minutes for ${DATE}"
            git push
          fi
```
